sql: UPDATE holding_column SET name='Invented' WHERE name='Slot2'
UPDATE holding_column SET storage_type='varchar' WHERE name='Slot2'
DELETE FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Excluded'; UPDATE meta SET value='8' WHERE key='census_tables'

INSERT INTO holding_column(holding_id,name,ordinal,storage_type,disposition) SELECT id,'Invented',10,'int','candidate' FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Pool'; INSERT INTO holding_notice(holding_id,column_id,code,message) SELECT holding_id,id,'mapping_missing','Not documented' FROM holding_column WHERE name='Invented'; UPDATE meta SET value='23' WHERE key='census_columns'
INSERT INTO holding_table(physical_name,file_name,disposition,reason) VALUES('Invented','invented','lookup','Not in census'); UPDATE meta SET value='10' WHERE key='census_tables'

DELETE FROM holding_mapping WHERE variable_pid='demo/held/id' AND column_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool'); INSERT INTO holding_notice(holding_id,column_id,code,message) SELECT c.holding_id,c.id,'mapping_missing','Required key withheld' FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Received_Id'; UPDATE meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)-1 WHERE key='mapped_columns'; UPDATE meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)+1 WHERE key='unmatched_columns';
UPDATE holding_table SET key_requirements='[]' WHERE physical_name='Pool'
UPDATE holding_table SET period_encoding='date' WHERE physical_name='Pool'

INSERT INTO holding_mapping(column_id,table_pid,variable_pid,start,end,role,carried) SELECT c.id,'demo/held','demo/held/id',m.start,m.end,'row_key',1 FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id JOIN holding_column original ON original.holding_id=h.id AND original.name='Received_Id' JOIN holding_mapping m ON m.column_id=original.id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Unknown'; UPDATE meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)+1 WHERE key='mapped_columns'; UPDATE meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)-1 WHERE key='unmatched_columns';
UPDATE holding_table SET partition=NULL WHERE physical_name='Part B'
UPDATE holding_period SET end=end+365 WHERE holding_id=(SELECT id FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Parent')
UPDATE holding_mapping SET carried=1 WHERE column_id=(SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table t ON t.id=c.holding_id WHERE t.physical_name='Child' AND c.name='ChildId')

DELETE FROM holding_mapping WHERE column_id=(SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table t ON t.id=c.holding_id WHERE t.physical_name='Parent' AND c.name='Id'); INSERT INTO holding_notice(holding_id,column_id,code,message) SELECT holding_id,id,'mapping_missing','Withheld parent key' FROM holding_column WHERE holding_id=(SELECT id FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Parent') AND name='Id'

UPDATE holding_column SET disposition='candidate',reason=NULL,follow_up=NULL WHERE holding_id=(SELECT id FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Pool') AND name='Received_Id'; INSERT INTO holding_mapping(column_id,table_pid,variable_pid,start,end,role,carried) SELECT c.id,'demo/held','demo/held/id',p.start,p.end,'row_key',0 FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id JOIN holding_period p ON p.holding_id=h.id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Received_Id'
UPDATE holding_mapping SET table_pid='demo/owners' WHERE column_id=(SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='AttestedMember' AND c.name='Id')
UPDATE holding_table SET projection_of=(SELECT id FROM holding_table WHERE physical_name='Part A') WHERE physical_name='Child'

UPDATE holding_mapping SET column_id=CASE column_id WHEN (SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Code') THEN (SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Year') ELSE (SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name='Code') END WHERE column_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM holding_column c JOIN holding_table h ON h.id=c.holding_id WHERE h.physical_name='Pool' AND c.name IN ('Code','Year'))
UPDATE holding_mapping SET end=end-1 WHERE variable_pid='demo/held/late'
UPDATE holding_mapping SET caveat=NULL WHERE variable_pid='steward/slots/code'
DELETE FROM holding_notice_candidate WHERE variable_pid='demo/owners/second'
